Source article title: Gloria J. Romero
Source introduction:
Gloria J. Romero (Republican Party) is running for election for Lieutenant Governor of California. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Romero (Democratic Party) was a member of the California State Senate, representing District 24. She assumed office in 2001. She left office in 2010.
Romero completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
On September 4, 2024, Romero announced she is leaving the Democratic Party and will switch to a Republican.

Gloria J. Romero (Republican Party) is running for election for Lieutenant Governor of California. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Romero (Democratic Party) was a member of the California State Senate, representing District 24. She assumed office in 2001. She left office in 2010.
Romero completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
On September 4, 2024, Romero announced she is leaving the Democratic Party and will switch to a Republican.
